subject: Pilot invoicing & temporary payment lane request - CardioMetrics
messages:
From: Avery Barnes <avery.barnes@cardiometrics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cardiometrics.com, Michael Sun <michael.sun@cardiometrics.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot invoicing and payment terms

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the pilot looks promising. Procurement asked me to confirm our preferred commercial terms so we can get purchase order approval. A couple of asks:

- Can Redwood bill on Net45 for the pilot (we typically push Net45 for new vendors)?
- We need a short invoice schedule showing milestone billing for the 90-day pilot so we can match against our budget line items.
- CardioMetrics operates in the EU through a subsidiary; please confirm how VAT will be handled (reverse charge or billed VAT). If you require our VAT registration, let me know and I’ll attach it.

If you can send an invoice cadence and any required tax docs, I’ll get procurement working on the PO.

Best,
Avery
Avery Barnes
CFO, CardioMetrics
avery.barnes@cardiometrics.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Avery Barnes <avery.barnes@cardiometrics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot invoicing and payment terms

Avery — thanks for the clear asks. We can work with Net45 for the pilot with a couple of guardrails so we don’t overexpose on usage during the ramp:

- Proposal: temporary Net45 for the first 90 days of the pilot, with milestone invoicing (invoice #1 at kickoff — 30%; invoice #2 at 30 days — 40%; invoice #3 at completion/90 days — 30%). See attached pilot-invoice-schedule.xlsx.
- Credit cap: to start, we can set a provisional credit corridor of $40,000. If usage materially exceeds projections, we’ll ask to pause or request a short-term prepay.
- VAT: for EU subsidiary invoices we offer VAT-exempt reverse-charge if you supply the VAT registration number and certificate. If you prefer Redwood to bill VAT, we can do that but it will appear on the invoice and be payable by CardioMetrics. Please attach the VAT cert and we’ll mark invoices accordingly.

Action items on our side: I’ll loop finance (Marissa) to confirm the temporary credit increase workflow and attach the MSA redline that Legal asked about. If you’re comfortable, share the VAT certificate and I’ll push the PO through.

I’ve attached the invoice schedule draft and a checklist of the docs we need.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Avery Barnes <avery.barnes@cardiometrics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Sun <michael.sun@cardiometrics.com>, procurement@cardiometrics.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot invoicing and payment terms

Neha — thanks, that structure looks reasonable. A few follow-ups from procurement and legal:

- Can CardioMetrics get a one-time increase to a $75k credit cap for the pilot? We anticipate higher token usage during model tuning. The team can provide daily usage reports if that helps.
- If a $75k cap isn’t possible, procurement wants to offer a one-time deposit (prepay) equal to the difference. Is that feasible?
- We will provide the VAT certificate (attached). Please indicate on the invoice whether reverse-charge will be applied.
- Legal wants a clean MSA rather than heavy redlines for a quick PO. Can you send your most current executable MSA (clean copy) and flag any non-negotiable clauses?

Cc’ing Michael (ops) for usage reporting cadence.

Regards,
Avery

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Avery Barnes <avery.barnes@cardiometrics.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot invoicing and payment terms — Finance confirmation

Hi Avery,

Marissa from Finance here — appreciate the clarity. We can support a temporary credit increase to $75,000 for the 90-day pilot under these conditions:

1) Signed MSA (clean copy) executed prior to the first invoice.
2) CardioMetrics provides VAT registration/certificate for the billing entity to enable reverse-charge treatment.
3) Daily usage reports to be shared via the agreed dashboard; if consumption exceeds 120% of the projected daily burn for 3 consecutive days, Redwood reserves the right to pause new requests and request a short-term prepayment.

If the above is acceptable, we’ll issue invoices on Net45 as requested. As a concession to speed approval, we can offer a 1.5% early-pay discount if an invoice is paid within 15 days of receipt.

Attached: Redline_MSA_neha_v1.pdf (clean copy with minimal required clauses highlighted), and the pilot invoice schedule (final). Please countersign the MSA and return.

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Avery Barnes <avery.barnes@cardiometrics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@cardiometrics.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot invoicing and payment terms — next steps

Avery — quick note to confirm next steps so we can get the PO moving:

- We will apply reverse-charge VAT for your EU subsidiary invoices once we receive the attached VAT certificate (received — thank you).
- Finance will provisionally enable the $75k credit corridor pending countersigned MSA (see attached DocuSign link). If the countersign completes by EOD Wednesday we’ll be able to invoice to kick off on the agreed schedule.
- Team will publish daily usage to the shared dashboard and send a brief usage summary to procurement each morning.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc1234
Attachments: signed-MSA-stub.pdf (sent via DocuSign), pilot-invoice-schedule.xlsx

I’ll follow up with the operations team (Michael) to share the dashboard onboarding link. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Neha
